categories.main_business_segments: Hengli Petrochemical operates primarily in the petrochemical industry, covering integrated refining, chemical production, and polyester fiber manufacturing. Its business segments include oil refining, production of aromatic hydrocarbons (PX, PTA), olefins (ethylene), polyester fibers (civil and industrial filament yarns), functional polyester films, engineering plastics, and biodegradable materials. The company also engages in downstream sales and distribution of petrochemical products and fibers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced large-scale refining and chemical processing technologies, including component refining, molecular refining, and integrated coal-to-chemical processes. It uses world-leading process packages and green environmental technologies for wastewater treatment and energy efficiency. Hengli has developed proprietary high-density polyethylene materials, ultra-fine fibers with international leading fineness, and advanced functional polyester films. It also integrates digital twin technology and industrial internet platforms for intelligent manufacturing and process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hengli serves a broad range of customers in textiles, automotive, electronics, packaging, construction, and new energy sectors. Its products are used in apparel, home textiles, industrial textiles, automotive tires and components, electronic components (MLCC films), lithium battery separators, and biodegradable packaging. The company targets both domestic and international markets, focusing on high-end and differentiated product segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with major production bases in Dalian, Jiangsu (Wujiang, Suzhou, Nantong), and Hainan Free Trade Port. It also has subsidiaries and trading entities in Hong Kong and Singapore to support international trade and logistics. Hengli's sales cover domestic Chinese markets extensively and export to overseas markets, with foreign currency transactions mainly in USD.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hengli operates as an integrated petrochemical platform covering upstream refining and chemical production, midstream production of key intermediates like PX, PTA, and ethylene, and downstream manufacturing of polyester fibers and functional materials. It controls a vertically integrated supply chain from crude oil and coal feedstocks to high-value-added chemical fibers and materials, positioning itself as a full-industry-chain leader.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven development, focusing on breaking technological bottlenecks and developing high-end differentiated products such as biodegradable PBS/PBAT materials, functional polyester films, and high-performance resins. It invests heavily in R&D, collaborates with academic institutions, and builds advanced research platforms. Hengli also emphasizes intelligent manufacturing and green low-carbon transformation, integrating digital technologies and sustainable practices to enhance competitiveness and environmental performance.
categories.revenue_model: Hengli generates revenue primarily through the sale of petrochemical products, including refined oil products, chemical intermediates (PX, PTA, ethylene), polyester fibers, functional films, and engineering plastics. Revenue streams include domestic and international product sales, with some income from government subsidies and financial investments. The company also earns from derivative financial instruments used for hedging commodity price risks.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hengli is a leading player in China's petrochemical and polyester fiber industry, distinguished by its large-scale integrated refining and chemical production capacity and advanced technology. It competes with major domestic and international petrochemical companies but holds a competitive edge through its cost leadership, scale, and innovation in high-end materials. Hengli is recognized as a pioneer in integrating oil, coal, and chemical processes and in developing differentiated fiber and film products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hengli achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 236.3 billion, a slight increase of 0.63% year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 7.044 billion, up 2.01%. Total assets reached RMB 2.73 trillion, growing 4.79% from the previous year. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with continuous investment in capacity expansion and R&D, supported by strong cash flows and diversified financing channels.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hengli emphasizes its integrated large-scale production platform, cost efficiency, and technological innovation as core competitive advantages. It offers high-quality, differentiated products such as ultra-fine fibers with international leading fineness, high-density polyethylene materials certified at PE100 level, and advanced functional polyester films breaking foreign technology barriers. The company also commits to sustainable development through green manufacturing and intelligent production, providing customers with reliable, innovative, and environmentally friendly materials.
